early_stop: After complete K32: stop if alpha2 accepted and its slowest measured step is no slower than the fastest reused joint step. Otherwise run K24 only on parent instruction. Infrastructure/contract failure stops the matrix; actual memory guard rejection permits K24.
reference: same-input original native N K16 for all alpha2 decisions
controls: existing native N K16 and unchanged 72-sample joint plan; no reruns
scope: finite-capacity per-input ablation, not an online varying-input execution
capacity_policy: unchanged native n^2/CP greedy/fill; only K varies; no joint adapter
training: 8 layers GGG*GGG*, TP=PP=1, full dense MLP/head/loss/F+B/finalize/clip/Adam/parameter sync; original content and masks; GDN including MLP contiguous
constraints: no workspace/source inventory, hashes, snapshots, environment checks, GPU preflight, profiling, additional numerical or GPU tests; keep actual physical memory guard
model_memory_prediction: K32 may exceed the analytic envelope; test actual training once, never relax runtime guard
